notes.title: Update 0.1.3.c
notes.content: [h2][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Increase combat timer for all levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased level sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Low Power” warning when a energy weapon capacitor is low resulting in decreased damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu lighting and planet texture now reflect the player’s current system.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Decreased Mk44 scattershot PDC damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase satellite infrared output so they can be targeted.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Ships[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Renamed the Tortus-class light destroyer to the Lawson-class and added a new ship model.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new ship model for the Cephus-class frigate.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed broken textures on the PN/PT radar and PLaWs 2 laser.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue causing NPC ships to spin uncontrollably.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue preventing beams from damaging cities.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.1.3.b Hotfix
notes.content: [p]I've got a handful of small improvements for 0.1.3.b based on community feedback. Enjoy![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Group buttons on the weapon status panel will now be greyed out if the group is disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Clarified armor’s ability to prevent leaks in upgrade descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented better logic for avoiding moon collisions when entering the battle space.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Shops now have the correct assortment of munitions for sale.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock caused by the mini map.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing “Quit” on the error crash popup should now actually quit the game.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Reduced surface settlement health.[/p][/*][*][p]Old Reliable ability now triggers at a higher health threshold and does less healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Expert Engineers ability now triggers at a lower reactor heat threshold and does less healing.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced LP3-9 PDC’s rate of fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased weapon heat generation for most early game weapons.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.1.3.a Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Thanks to the community for great catches on bugs and feedback on 0.1.3 already![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with new fleet animations causing soft-locks in galaxy map after restarting a campaign or destroying an enemy fleet.[/p][/*][*][p]Radiation cloud damage now starts higher and scales down over time, instead of starting too low..[/p][/*][*][p]Coolant volume bar is now correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Radiation damage no longer causes fuel or coolant leaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stars not covering the full screen from some angles.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tubba now comes standard with the Scrappy ability which gives 100% damage against larger ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the Scrappy ability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Unique lighting for each system.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Periapsis: Eclipse 0.1.3 Update
notes.content: [p][b]Welcome to the Periapsis: Eclipse 0.1.3 demo update![/b] 0.1.3 addresses tons of feedback the community has sent in since the demo launched. Some of the main requests were more quality of life features, better balanced heat and power management and more challenging combat. I hope you enjoy these changes to the demo![/p][p]Periapsis: Eclipse is still in very early days so features, balance and mechanics will change as I continue to improve the game. Please jump into the Discord to chat about the update with the community and let me know what you think![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Replaced sphere of influence gravitation with n-body gravitation.[/p][/*][*][p]Player is now more consistently credited for indirect kills.[/p][/*][*][p]Added warnings for dangerous ship conditions such as high reactor heat or low battery.[/p][/*][*][p]High reactor heat can now cause periodic explosions and fuel leaks.[/p][/*][*][p]High coolant heat can now cause periodic coolant leaks.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked beam weapon aiming for smoother inaccuracy.[/p][/*][*][p]Directional missile payloads can now independently rotate towards their target independently of the missile body when they deploy.[/p][/*][*][p]Power generation now scales with coolant circulation rate, allowing higher pump speeds to charge the battery more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Radiators now have efficiency zones where they will cool down coolant faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased atmospheric drag.[/p][/*][*][p]Fleets in the galaxy map now orbit around planets.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added the ability to speed up time while the player ship is not engaged or maneuvering. Hotkey default is left control.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a scrap shop where you can trade scrap for gear.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a refinery shop where fuel and coolant can be purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]Dials can now be turned up or down with right and left click, respectively.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkeys menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added lower intensity combat music.[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap now shows the direction of visible ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now lock the camera to their ship using a button on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now lock their ship’s heading prograde, retrograde or radially using buttons on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now middle mouse click directly on a ship to begin missile locking.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkey to reload all weapons. Hotkey default is R.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hotkey to cycle all weapon groups through weapon modes. Hotkey default is Capslock.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the encyclopedia screen to provide better detail.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]AI[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a close-range maneuvering mode for NPC ships for finer tuned collision avoidance using RCS as well as main engines.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated AI to take two steps of future hypothetical trajectories into account when deciding on a maneuver.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Buffed all NPC ship health, armor and damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced NPC ship spawn rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Full rebalance of heat and power generation to create more dynamic operation.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced laser damage over distance to scale more linearly.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of control rods available to each ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Cobra-6 missile payload size.[/p][/*][*][p]Tightened Adderstrike missile projectile cone for more focused damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Tightened Mk44 PDC projectile spread for more focused damage.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Tutorial[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added a new step to the tutorial to explain how to collect cargo crates.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial step to explain manual target selection in AUTO mode.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Radiation damage upgrade can now be correctly applied to projectile weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Radiation shielding upgrade description is now correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing the first tutorial combat to never end if the player took too long.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing missiles to not be auto selected when entering combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue causing cargo crates and fuel tanks to fly away from wrecks too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue causing satellites to not be collectable with the harpoon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing music volume to reset after combat victory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue allowing multiple instances of an upgrade to be added at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing shop buttons to play their animation without purchasing the item.[/p][/*][*][p]Various stability and soft-lock fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Various tutorial edge-case fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]A crash after completing a combat level when an object is incorrectly disposed of may occur.[/p][/*][*][p]NPC ships can sometimes start spinning and have trouble stopping.[/p][/*][*][p]Trajectory prediction through atmosphere may be inconsistent.[/p][/*][*][p]NPC drone launches often collide with their mother ship.[/p][/*][/list]
